name: Meal photos fan in, checklist ticks to send
looks: A headline lands, then three overlapping meal photos fan in and settle at small seeded angles above a grocery checklist. The list's items tick off one by one, gaining a check and a strikethrough, until a green 'sent' button is pressed at the bottom.
build: script-accent-underline for the headline; variant-stack-reveal for the photo fan (seeded rotation and offset, settling square-ish but still gently overlapped); each checklist row's check and strikethrough land together on their own beat, fastest at the end, finishing with the button's press-scale (0.045s down, 0.14s release).
sound: A soft shutter-like click per photo landing, a tick per checklist item, and a confirm chime on the send button.
prompt: Prove a plan became real groceries: fan in a few photos of the finished result, then tick off a checklist item by item beneath them, each gaining a check and a strikethrough, ending on a single button press that sends the list onward.
